text:
omar_infra: Noticed dedicated-pool-delta (eu2-dedicated-03) saturated intermittently overnight. Throughput OK but allocator keeps moving small bursty jobs in and out, causing slab churn + higher preempt rate.
lena_sched: which tenants are causing churn?
omar_infra: mostly three tenants that run short-lived token-by-token RPC tests: tenant-batch-21, tenant-experiments, tenant-internal-fx. They consume burst tokens fast, then get moved back out. Burst credits show negative balance on pool ledger.
bryan_ops: that explains the slab churn alerts. We're hitting preemption waterfall: preempt cheap jobs -> free slab -> scheduler backfills with more bursty jobs -> repeat.
june_sre: Any change in admission controls or burst caps recently?
omar_infra: No config change. Looks correlated with a deploy from antsy_dev at 02:13UTC which enabled aggressive retry on client side (token size small) -> massively increased pps.
antsy_dev: oof my bad, testing harness hammered the fleet. I can roll back the client change.
lena_sched: We need stopgap before rolling tenant clients: 1) isolate bursty tenants into a "burst-isolate" fractional dedicated pool spread across AZs; 2) enforce a per-tenant token-bucket rate at proxy; 3) reduce scheduler backfill weight for that slice to avoid thrash.
bryan_ops: agree, but watch cost. Creating more fractional dedicated slices will inflate reserved capacity unless we map to preemptible hosts.
billingbot: FYI projection: moving three tenants to a dedicated burst slice in eu2 for 24hrs => +$2.3k/day on reserved vs preemptible model.
june_sre: Can we create the slice but mark it preemptible with lower SLO? that would isolate noise without raising reserved spend too much.
lena_sched: yes we have preemptible fractional slices. Plan: create slice burst-isolate-eu2-preemptible and steer those three tenants there with a soft-weight first.
omar_infra: quick commands to tag tenants and add slice weight (safe-mode):
```bash
# tag tenants for soft routing
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-batch-21 routing=bust-isolate
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-experiments routing=bust-isolate
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-internal-fx routing=bust-isolate
# soft weight (20%) via scheduler api
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://scheduler.internal/api/v1/routes/weights \
  -d '{"slice":"burst-isolate-eu2-preemptible","weight":0.2,"region":"eu2"}'
```
bryan_ops: opsbot, create INC for pool-thrash and set paging to SRE if preemptions > 5/min for 10m?
opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-4720 "eu2 dedicated slab thrash". Paging threshold set.
june_sre: Also deploy eBPF probe to capture per-tenant pps and ring occupancy. Add a flag in telemetry to mark 'burst-tag' so we can correlate.
lena_sched: After soft redirect for 20m, if preemption rate drops >50% we promote to 50% then full. If not, revert and roll back client change.
antsy_dev: rolling my change back now. will update in 5m. Sorry team.
billingbot: Note: if we keep slice preemptible, unit cost ~30% lower; if tenants need guaranteed capacity we'll need reserved carveout and invoice changes.
bryan_ops: long-term action items: - enforce per-tenant pacing in the proxy w/ token-bucket; - scheduler-level soft-quota to avoid backfill thrash; - telemetry alert for burst-credit depletion.
june_sre: Also consider NIC-level shpaping per-tenant at host eBPF to prevent irq storms.
omar_infra: taking runbook notes: "burst-isolate soft-redirect" steps + rollback conditions.
lena_sched: ok enact now?
omar_infra: starting 20% soft redirect at 03:02UTC.
opsbot: Alert suppression enabled for 10m while mitigation active.
june_sre: 03:18UTC update: preemption rate down 48%, slab churn alerts muted. per-host ring occupancy down ~37%.
bryan_ops: good signal. proceed to 50% soft-redirect. capture billing delta and allocate to antsy_dev test budget for today.
antsy_dev: will cover incremental cost from my test env. again apologies.
lena_sched: recording that we should add automated detection: if tenant pps > X for Y seconds AND burst-credit burn > Z then auto-soft-redirect.
june_sre: agree. I'll file an RFC for scheduler + proxy changes.
omar_infra: closing note: even with client rollback we should keep the burst-isolate slice for 24h to monitor. will merge runbook into infra-playbooks. thanks all :thumbsup:
